subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Urban Legends as Myth
description: A micro-lesson that makes Urban Legends as Myth usable.

hook.text: A babysitter gets threatening calls. The police trace them—they're coming from inside the house.

buildup.text: Urban legends spread like myths: orally, with variations, and always claimed to be true.

discovery.text: They serve the same function: encoding cultural fears. Poisoned candy warns about stranger danger.

twist.text: The internet accelerated them. Creepypasta stories are campfire tales for the digital age.

climax.text: Humans need scary stories. They rehearse danger safely. Myth never died—it moved online.

punchline.text: The call is always from inside the house.

quiz.question: What function do urban legends serve according to folklorists?
